description: This PHP source file defines a class `RequestForwardableExceptionSubscriber` that subscribes to exception events in a Symfony-based framework. It handles exceptions of type `RequestForwardableException` by forwarding the request to a specified controller and stopping propagation of the event.

classes.name: RequestForwardableExceptionSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens to kernel exception events and forwards requests when a specific exception is thrown.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this subscriber is interested in, specifically the EXCEPTION event in Symfony kernel.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles the exception event, checks if the exception is a RequestForwardableException, and forwards the request accordingly.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns array mapping KernelEvents::EXCEPTION to handler method.
